ig_carousel_topic.topic: Why variance is real and one losing month proves nothing
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text: One losing month doesn't mean your edge is gone.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text: Most bettors assume a cold streak means the system is broken. It isn't. At a 54% win rate, you will still lose 3 or 4 in a row multiple times a season. That's not failure. That's math.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text: A coin flipped 100 times will land heads 40 times in a row at some point over a large enough sample. Betting works the same way. Short-run results are noise. The edge lives in the long run.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text: Real example: a 54% win rate over 480 picks produces a 10-game losing streak roughly once every 60 days. Our current record is 259-221 with +40.1u net. There were bad weeks inside that number. Plenty of them.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text: One month of losses tells you almost nothing. 300 graded picks tell you everything. Track the sample, not the streak.
ig_carousel_topic.caption: One bad month doesn't erase a real edge. 259-221, +40.1u this year. The math holds over time, not over a week. Save this if you've ever wanted to quit after a cold run.
